remarks: Located on Wallacks Point, Stamford's only private waterfront neighborhood, this elegant 5-bedroom colonial home is surrounded by magnificent gardens and a swimming pool retreat with a view of Long Island Sound. Set on .74 acres abutting a nature preserve, this luxurious property features gardens, bluestone terraces, and walkways designed to reveal year-round seasonal pageantry. The light-filled entry sets the tone for entertaining in the expansive living room with fireplace, book-lined library, and formal dining room. The sensational gourmet kitchen and breakfast room offer an array of culinary appointments: 2"-thick calcite counters, center island, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Viking stove, double ovens, and wine cooler. Custom millwork, soaring cathedral ceilings, and hardwood floors are found throughout the home. The primary suite, with views across the pool, gardens and nature preserve, includes walk-in closets, a spacious bathroom with double sinks, oversized tub, and walk-in shower. Four additional bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and a fabulous great room provide space and comfort for family and guests. This meticulously maintained home on Wallacks Point provides privacy and is perfect for entertaining. Enjoy year-round activities on Long Island Sound, including boating, fishing, swimming, and sailing. Located less than 10 minutes from Stamford train station, Chelsea Piers, local fine dining and shopping, this home offers the perfect combination of amenities and location.
